title: To the rescue!
text: Viator really came to the rescue with finding tickets to the Alhambra when they were sold out. We even were able to get the preferred time of entry for the Nasrid Palace. Viator kept in touch along the way and communicated well with instructions on how to proceed with the tickets. Highly recommend if you’re in a bind with Alhambra tix!
author: joanbL8081GB

title: A must see historical...
text: A must see historical site when staying in Granada.  Steep hill to get there but taxi and bus options available.
author: Elaine_A

title: Last minute tickets
text: Was able to get tickets very last minute.Thanks so much. Was a little concerned it was a scam but they are legit and we were delighted.

title: worth the money you pay
text: Very useful service in these periods when the official site is all sold out, it is worth the money you pay. Alhambra and Nasrid palaces all very beautiful, thanks a lot Vayor team.

title: I would contact them again without a doubt
text: At the beginning I was uncertain because I didn't know the service, but the first contact gave me a good impression. I found availability, clarity, and a professional approach. If I were to have difficulty again with a highly requested visit, I would know where to ask for help.

title: Very quick response
text: I sent a message and received a reply shortly afterwards. Helpful service and very easy communication.

title: They saved us from a huge disappointment
text: We were travelling with two teenagers who had been looking forward to seeing the Alhambra for months. When we found out that tickets were sold out, we thought our plans had fallen apart. We decided to ask for help and received attentive support. It really meant a lot to our family.
